DOCUMENTED PDR DRIFT recorded honestly: FR-VERT-05 specifies the literal viewBox="0 0 200 400", but the shipped SVG uses "0 0 360 470" (DESIGN §6.2). The first cut used the PDR literal 200×400; code-reviewer CR-001 (high) found that box too narrow — right-side band-name labels and the opening tag overflowed the viewBox edge and clipped, failing FR-VERT-06. The two owned requirements were in tension and only the wider DESIGN box satisfies BOTH, so 360×470 was adopted (BAND_X=78, BAND_W=150, wide right gutter). The load-bearing FR-VERT-05 contract — a viewBox + preserveAspectRatio + width-responsive container with no fixed pixel size — holds either way. spec.md/design.md/tasks.md record 360×470 as shipped and flag the PDR literal for a docs-pass reconciliation (design.md Open Questions). spec_compliant: true against the FR-VERT-05 contract (responsive viewBox, no fixed pixels), with the numeric-literal drift flagged rather than silently matched.
